title: Храни меня, Небесная Стражница! OVA
alt: 伝心まもって守護月天! 伝心 まもって守護月天！
description: In the peaceful life of modern Japan, Shaorin and Tasuke explore their relationship amid familiar interventions and new challenges. Shaorin begins to discover why she chose to stay with Tasuke, and Tasuke begins to learn the depth of his love toward Shaorin. (Source: Anime News Network)

en:
In the peaceful life of modern Japan, Shaorin and Tasuke explore their relationship amid familiar interventions and new challenges. Shaorin begins to discover why she chose to stay with Tasuke, and Tasuke begins to learn the depth of his love toward Shaorin.



(Source: Anime News Network)
ja: 伝心 まもって守護月天！
